review_evidence: Extracted the 1212 paths from the brief; all 1212 exist in reservoir-sources/QudeLeap__Lean-QuantumAlg and all are .lean.
Declaration grep including the Lean module-system `public` modifier: 1189 files match, 23 do not.
Read QuantumAlg/Algorithms/AmplitudeEstimation.lean completely: module header, two public imports, and a module docstring describing the amplitude-estimation endpoint.

Read QuantumAlg/Algorithms/Grover.lean, QuantumAlg/Algorithms/Factoring/ShorStyle.lean, QuantumAlg/Algorithms/Classical/NumberTheory/GCD.lean completely: copyright, `module`, public imports only (GCD.lean also has a one-line module docstring).

Read QuantumAlg/Algorithms/Factoring/EkeraHastadStyle/StoreMachine/Recovery/Batch/Output.lean and .../Quadratic/Selection/Candidate.lean: public imports of the Correctness and Resources submodules only.

Read QuantumAlg/Algorithms/EllipticCurve/P256/Resources/Problem.lean completely: contains `public def problem`, the certified P-256 ECDLP problem specification with input/output/resource/success docstring.
Read the head of QuantumAlg/Algorithms/OrderFinding/Exact/Specification.lean: namespace, noncomputable section, and a documented exact-dyadic order-finding problem specification.

Smallest files: Factoring/ShorStyle.lean 221 B, Grover.lean 264 B, Classical/NumberTheory/GCD.lean 310 B (all import aggregators). Largest: OrderFinding/Probability.lean 107353 B, Factoring/EkeraHastadStyle/QueryModel/Native/Batch/Probability.lean 62150 B, Grover/Construction.lean 53960 B (proof-bearing source).
No file in the unit contains #eval, #guard, #check or #print commands.
summary: Surveyed all 1212 listed .lean files (9,257,626 bytes; 803 under Algorithms/Factoring, 158 EllipticCurve, 80 FiniteCyclicDLP, 64 OrderFinding, rest across AmplitudeEstimation, QPE, Grover, Simon, Classical, DeutschJozsa, BernsteinVazirani and top-level module files). Grepped every file for line-start declarations (theorem/lemma/def/structure/class/instance/inductive/abbrev/example/axiom/opaque, allowing public/private/noncomputable/meta modifiers): 1189 files contain declarations. The 23 files without declarations are module aggregators made of public import lines plus copyright and module docstrings (some also carry section/end); these stay primary-eligible under FILTER-007 because no deployed auxiliary channel was verified. No generated data, benchmark output, or duplicated content was found. Disposition: retain all files.
